title: Resolver fixes in 1.52
summary: Generic receivers (`TObjectList<T>.Create`) typed; index --resolve-only without a library keeps the last library bindings
intro: Read this when find-callers misses a call on a generic list or on an element read through a default indexer (also one an ancestor declares, 1.52.3), or when an index --resolve-only run without --library-db used to lose every library binding.
